note: Copy to models.json (git-ignored) and pass --models models.json. These are the OpenRouter serving settings recorded in the paper's FORGE episode logs: luna, sonnet and grok are the three-model cohort; gemini-3.7-flash and glm-5.3 joined in the five-model clear-goal study. Model availability and prices change over time. The API key is read from OPENROUTER_API_KEY, never from this file. Optional price_in / price_out (USD per million tokens) are a fallback when the provider reports no cost.
